calendar.deltas_vs_w1: A2 +2 write / +2 commit; hop-1 -1 write / -2 commit / -1 raw read / -2 read return; net +1 / 0 / -1 / -2
calendar.dependent_read_rule_hop1: raw read must be strictly after raw write: Q+6 > P+11+lane, i.e. Q >= P+6+lane (w1: Q >= P+4+lane)
calendar.source: calibrated in tb_dsfd_vm_a2f_diff (isolated write / read), then held exact for every record of the run; see latency_lines

mutants_must_fail.mut_lane: DSFD_VM_A2F_MUT_LANE (slice 0: record of bank k on the data lane of bank k^1)
mutants_must_fail.mut_rel: DSFD_VM_A2F_MUT_HOP1_REL (hop-1 storage with the legacy release edge E0+10: the missing hop-1 edge)
mutants_must_fail.par_capword / par_wfcpair / par_x43phase: the S-FUNC master mutants on the A2-F parent

write_sources.24..27: static landing dsfd_vm_static_landing o_v/o_row/o_d lanes 0..3 = scan a0, scan a1, selector, collector (mask ffff, tag c; LARM groups 0 / 5 / 6 from engine 12)
write_sources.28..31: Engram MIX4 f_mx_wq* lane c-28 (tag c)
write_sources.44..47: collective landing rows (dsfd_vm_static_xio cl_*; tag = compiler cl_t)
write_sources.52: WFC kit writes (dsfd_vm_static_wfc wf_*; mask ffff, tag 52)

port_map.front_inputs: dsfd_vm_a2f_core p_src (the legacy wiring, unchanged) -> s81_a2f_controlled_split4m i_v[c], i_row[14c+:14], i_tag[8c+:8], i_mask[16c+:16] (slice x = bits 4x..4x+3), i_data[512c+:512] (slice x = bits 128x..); the W0 header / 4 payload leaves are the source pin registers (edge P), control4 x4 samples i_row[7:0] directly at P for the bank lane
port_map.front_to_storage: bank-linear o_slice_v[32x+k], o_slice_row[14(32x+k)], o_slice_tag[8(32x+k)], o_mask[16k+4x], o_data[512k+128x] -> dsfd_vm_static_scatter_b8_out PIPE 1 (slice x, group k/8) -> relay128_b8 (x, k/8) write -> bank128 (x, k) [HOP1: no b4]; the legacy logical packet J = 8 (k mod 4) + k/4 and the 128 write_capture128 leaves are gone
port_map.read: rsched (dsfd_vm_a2f_rsched_p REL 8) n_v/n_row/n_slot/n_group, a_v/a_row -> per slice dsfd_vm_static_suhc_fsr_split (unchanged) -> b8 read request -> bank128 -> b8 response -> dsfd_vm_static_return32_native_lanes (release / prepare at E0+8 / E0+7) -> dsfd_vm_static_suhc_return_map -> native_v/data, group_v/data -> read router (unchanged): SU / HC / PQ / aux / MIX outputs
port_map.commit: bank128 o_commit/o_ca/o_cm/o_ct -> b8 response -> commit_v[32x+k], commit_addr[9(32x+k)], commit_mask[4(32x+k)], commit_tag[8(32x+k)] -> dsfd_vm_seq_tile o_cv/o_ca/o_cm (engine-12 CHECK), the legacy layout
port_map.faults: m_flt[40] legacy layout ([10x+:4] FSR, [10x+4] = OR of the 4 scatter faults, [10x+5+:4] return lanes, [10x+9] native map); w_flt = OR of the 16 registered A2-F quarter faults (fault_join4), re-registered in the seq tile

clock_reset_ports.unchanged: every functional port; ck/rss core, rsched, seq, landing, mem_fsr 16, mem_return 16/4, mem_bank 128, mem_wscatter 16 (now PIPE-1 scatter), read_data 64, read_valid 8, all serial-side cap / wfc / xio / x34 / x43 roots
clock_reset_ports.width_changed: ck/rss_write_control_t 1 -> 4 (s81_a2f_control4_resetlocal per slice); ck_mem_relay_req_t / rsp_t and rss_mem_relay_t 48 -> 16 (b8 only, bit 4*slice+group; the 32-entry b4 tail is pruned)
clock_reset_ports.new: ck/rss_write_meta_t 28 (7 metadata field4 leaves per slice), ck/rss_write_data_t 128 (32 data field4 leaves per slice: 32*slice + 4*field + nibble), ck/rss_write_fault_t 4 (fault_join4 per slice)
